title: UI风格#181 - Sticker Art (贴纸艺术)
description: 创建第181种UI风格：贴纸艺术风格 - 涂鸦贴纸效果、随手绘制、不干胶质感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art style When color palette Then features vibrant mixed colors, marker tones, paper white
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FF6B6B (涂鸦红), #4ECDC4 (薄荷绿), #FFE66D (荧光黄), #FFFFFF (白色), #2C2C2C (黑色)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art style When typography Then uses hand drawn: Permanent Marker, Architects Daughter, or Comic Sans
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Permanent Marker (马克笔), Architects Daughter (手绘), Comic Sans (涂鸦)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art style When layout Then scattered sticker placement, overlapping elements, paper backing visible
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：散落贴纸放置、重叠元素、可见纸背衬

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art style When UI elements Then peel animation, sticker bounce, marker stroke, tape accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：剥离动画、贴纸弹跳、马克笔笔触、胶带点缀

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art UI When functional Then includes doodle chat, sticker agents, playful stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：涂鸦聊天、贴纸代理、活泼统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sticker Art UI When copy Then uses playful: 'Sticker', 'Doodle', 'Peel', 'Pop'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'STICKER. DOODLE. PEEL.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'POP'、'DEPLOY'→'STICK'
